verdict.rationale: Supabase's llms.txt points to an OpenAPI 3.0 description of the Management API at supabase.com/openapi.json. An independent probe confirmed that URL returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key, so the spec is downloadable and machine-readable. missing for 10: no evidence of a downloadable OpenAPI spec for the per-project auto-generated REST/Data API (only the Management API spec is documented), and no first-party docs page describing spec usage or versioning beyond the llms.txt listing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Supabase Management API OpenAPI spec (https://supabase.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.0 description of the Management API for managing organizations, projects, branches, and configuration
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://supabase.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
